# Anne Shirley & Rilla Blythe

- [Rilla Blythe](../character/rilla-blythe.md) — Child of — [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — mother · since v5  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P20](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0020)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> On a spring evening at [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) sit on the veranda with sleeping children [Rilla](../character/rilla-blythe.md) and [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) while awaiting a visit from [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) chat about being back home after three months in [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe), enjoying local gossip and reflecting on neighbors' lives as [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) approaches.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P2](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0002), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P8](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P16](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0016)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Miss Cornelia discuss Anne's recent trip to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe) and her appreciation for [Canada](../codex/places.md#canada) and [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds). They talk about [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), who will give music lessons to the twins, and mention that the Fords are traveling to [Japan](../codex/places.md#japan). After Miss Cornelia leaves, [Susan](../character/susan.md) puts [Rilla](../character/rilla-blythe.md) to bed while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) sits outside enjoying the moonrise over the harbor.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P57](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0057), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P63](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0063), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P67](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0067), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P71](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0071)_

> [Rilla](../character/rilla-blythe.md) carries a basket of strawberries to the manse, but [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) frightens her by chasing her with a dried codfish. [Rilla](../character/rilla-blythe.md) falls into a mud puddle and is rescued by Miss Cornelia, who takes her home to [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside). Afterward, Miss Cornelia, [Susan](../character/susan.md), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discuss Mary's mischievous antics and potential matches for the local minister.
>
